description: Check a Zillow rental listing before you apply: what similar rentals nearby ask, how long it has really been listed (Zillow's counter resets on a relist), whether and how much it has been cut, what empty weeks cost the landlord, an offer, a likely settling point, and a message to send. Takes a Zillow listing link or its numeric id. Works best in San Diego County; elsewhere it uses the listings Lowball has seen nearby. Estimates, never a guarantee. Not affiliated with Zillow. Docs: https://github.com/peterskotte123/lowball-plugin#readme

autopay.description: Add an autopay line to the message.

lease_months.description: Lease term to put in the message. Default 12.

url.description: A zillow.com/homedetails/... link, or the numeric zpid from it.

name: check_rent
